text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy,rustfmt
          override: true

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test

      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --release
```
